panels.title: ABOUT
panels.text: Senior engineering judgment as audit-first Claude Code skills. One plugin per domain: 73 skills across 7 plugins, shipped as the Claude Code marketplace `frontendskills`. It does not write your app. It tells you where the seams go.

items.text: Ships as the Claude Code marketplace `frontendskills`: 73 skills in 7 plugins, licensed MIT.
React 19 / Vue 3 · Hono / Go / FastAPI · Supabase / Next 16 · Vercel / Hetzner / IONOS · Rust + Bevy.

items.lead: No change on a second run
items.text: Reads your stack profile first, applies only the missing move, and changes nothing on a second run.
Every rule ships with its **when to deviate**. The aim is judgment, not dogma.

Add the marketplace, install `devcore`, then ask Claude to "set up my stack profile". The wizard detects the stack, asks only the gaps, writes `.claude/stack-profile.md`, and prints the plugins to enable.
Every plugin depends on `devcore`, so installing any of them installs it too.
Each enabled skill keeps its one-line `Use when` description in context, and loads in full only when that line matches.
Install only the plugins your stack uses; the rest cost nothing.
Claude Code 2.1.275 or later adds the marketplace on the way. See `REFERENCE.md`.
Run `/plugin marketplace update frontendskills`.

items.text: Each skill inspects what is already there and applies only the missing move. A second run is a no-op.
The router shares the `queryClient` with loaders, guards, forms and realtime. One OpenTelemetry pipeline ships every service's telemetry to one collector.
Every skill reads `.claude/stack-profile.md` first, so the author's defaults (pnpm, Biome, tests in `tests/`) stay defaults.
The full diagram and the composition chains are in `REFERENCE.md`.

panels.title: THE PLUGINS · EVERY SKILL IS IN REFERENCE.MD

rows.text: The stack-profile wizard, security and toolchain audits, commit and PR writing. **6 skills.**
Vite-SPA lifecycle (React 19 / Vue 3) plus landing & content pages. **26 + 5 skills.**
Hono / Go / FastAPI services, Supabase, Next 16. **15 skills.**
Containers, OpenTofu, deploys, secrets, OTel collector. **8 skills.**
Command-line tools and the dev toolchain. **3 skills.**
LLM seams, RAG, evals, MCP servers. **5 skills.**

items.text: Commit the same setup to the project's `.claude/settings.json`, so everyone who trusts the folder gets the skills. The exact JSON is in `REFERENCE.md`.
Run the wizard once per repo and commit the resulting `.claude/stack-profile.md`.
`bash scripts/validate.sh` checks every marketplace entry, the shared version, catalogue ownership, every `SKILL.md`, and every relative `.md` link under `skills/`.
CI runs the same script on every pull request.

rows.text: The design narrative: every load-bearing decision as **X over Y, for Z**.
The house style, and how to add a skill that fits.
The full catalogue, install commands and run example.
The schema every skill reads first, and its precedence.
The Adopt/Hold lines the defaults come from.
The shared security bar behind `audit-security` and `harden-backend`.
The audience contract: one text the junior can follow, the senior can verify, the CTO can skim.
The seam map: how one `queryClient` threads the whole app.
The one canonical `fetcher`, base and auth versions.
One layering standard for TypeScript, Go, and Python.
The public-page gate and the priority inversion.

items.text: One marketplace, seven plugins, 73 skills.
Every code block in the catalogues was built and run in scratch projects on 2026-10-09. Anything not run is labelled unverified in place.
Versions are floors in each catalogue's `_shared/stack-versions.md`.
`bash scripts/validate.sh` exits 0 when every rule passes. Changes land in `CHANGELOG.md`.
